items.title: A non-Wire `[derive(Wire)]` field (tuple, array, closure, or a plain non-Wire struct) and a NOMINAL non-Wire `[rpc]` parameter are refused by the boundary check and then restated by the generated code at the attribute — "Password has no method 'describe'", "cannot find 'rebuild' in Password", "(i32, i32) has no method 'describe'", "this expression cannot be used as a type" (a closure field emitted bare)
items.body: E296 stood the `[service]` attribute's generated-code diagnostics down for a tuple/array/closure/view `[rpc]` type (reusing B490's `rpc_opaque_return_origins` filter at the end of `analyze`), and B597 fixed the `_` quote. What is left is the same restatement for (a) every `[derive(Wire)]` field the boundary check refuses — the derive's generated `describe`/`rebuild` bodies fail at the derive attribute for each refused field, 3-4 extra errors at a span the author did not write, for nominal types as much as for tuples — and (b) a nominal non-Wire `[rpc]` parameter (`fun a(self, p: Password)` draws "Password has no method 'describe'" at the attribute beside the signature refusal; B303's stand-down covers only the bound-failure path). Fix: record the derive's origin (the `derived_origins` row of the Wire impl) in the same stand-down set when `check_wire_boundary` refuses a field, and widen E296's origin insert from non-nominal forms to every refused `[rpc]` type; the closure-field case also needs the Wire derive to stop emitting a closure type bare in expression position (std/json.vl's derive). Pins: one error per refused field/parameter. Sizing S; analyzer core (check_wire_boundary, the rpc signature check, the final filter).

items.discussion: tools-51 (Order 51); M135's measurement, kolt client `check src/client.vl`, release build, VILAN_PHASE_TIMING=passes
items.title: With M135's disk table the const pass still costs ~47 ms CPU on kolt's client for 168 served sites — const-interp 6 ms, site lowering 9 ms, and ~32 ms in neither: ConstWorld::new, check_const_only/check_const_functions, the per-site reach walk, live_tokens_of's scan of every result, run_finalisers
items.body: M135's gate was 'kolt client cold const pass <= 10% of today's 173-251 ms'; the evaluation (the part a result cache removes) was 208 of 258 ms CPU and is now 6, but the pass is 47 ms CPU warm (18% of its cold cost). The rest is work every check does whatever the cache holds. Profile first (callgrind on `check src/client.vl` with the table warm; the const-lower/const-interp split is in `VILAN_PHASE_TIMING=passes`), then: key the reach walk and the lowering by the same content hash so a hit skips both, memoize `live_tokens_of` per result, and see whether `ConstWorld::new` lowers the whole world for sites that all hit. Expected: the warm pass under ~20 ms. Sizing S–M; const_eval.rs / transformer's ConstWorld (fix-51's files).
